title: Ali Meoo Suiwu Launches Team Edition and Integrates Qwen-3.8-Max Model

content_html:
AliAI application creation platform Meoo (Miao Wu) recently launched its team version and integrated the Qwen-3.8-Max model, offering subscription services to teams and enterprise users. The new version focuses on enterprise collaboration needs, adding features such as unified identity management, a shared credit pool, a permission system, and a team skill market.

Meoo was launched in April this year. Users do not need programming experience; they can generate applications, websites, H5 pages, or WeChat mini programs by simply describing their needs in natural language, and it supports one-click deployment. This team version upgrade mainly addresses enterprises' needs in resource management, application sharing, and access control.

In terms of management capabilities, enterprise members can log in using their Alibaba Cloud accounts. Teams can purchase seats and credits collectively, and administrators can allocate quotas based on member needs. Meanwhile, the platform supports centralized management of applications, skills, and cloud resources, and provides a three-level permission system: owner, administrator, and regular member.

Additionally, Meoo introduced a team skill market, allowing users to package business capabilities such as pricing rules and approval processes into reusable "skills," helping enterprises accumulate digital assets. The platform also supports custom domain deployment and added a "personalized memory" feature that can record user preferences, project rules, and business terminology.

content_html_zh:
AliAI应用创建平台Meoo（吴淼）近日推出团队版，集成Qwen-3.8-Max模型，为团队和企业用户提供订阅服务。 新版本聚焦企业协作需求，新增统一身份管理、共享信用池、权限体系、团队技能市场等功能。

Meoo于今年4月推出。 用户不需要编程经验；他们只需用自然语言描述自己的需求，就可以生成应用程序、网站、H5页面或微信小程序，并且支持一键部署。 本次团队版本升级主要解决企业在资源管理、应用共享、访问控制等方面的需求。

在管理能力方面，企业会员可以使用阿里云账号登录。 团队可以集体购买席位和积分，管理员可以根据成员需求分配配额。 同时，平台支持应用、技能、云资源的集中管理，并提供所有者、管理员、普通会员三级权限体系。

此外，Meoo还推出了团队技能市场，允许用户将定价规则、审批流程等业务能力打包成可重复使用的“技能”，帮助企业积累数字资产。 该平台还支持自定义域部署，并添加了“个性化记忆”功能，可以记录用户偏好、项目规则和业务术语。
